answer_1.quote: We propose a framework that obfuscates stylistic features of human-generated text by automatically re-writing the text itself... We introduce a novel framework that enables 'style pooling': the automatic transduction of user-generated text to a central, obfuscated style.
answer_1.outputs: Obfuscated/re-written sentences with reduced stylistic cues

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the removal of sensitive attributes, fluency of the generated text, and the uncertainty of a sensitive attribute classifier... we report BLEU score, GLEU score, GPT-2 perplexity, back‑translation accuracy, lexical diversity, classifier accuracy, entropy, and confident response.

answer_4.quote: We design two crowd-sourcing tasks on Amazon Mechanical Turk. (1) Fluency: We provide workers with a pair of obfuscated sentences, and ask them which sentence is more fluent. (2) Semantic Consistency: We provide the original (un‑obfuscated) sentences, and ask workers which of the obfuscated sentences is closer in meaning to the original sentence.
answer_4.guideline: Workers were asked to choose the more fluent sentence and to choose the sentence that is closer in meaning to the original sentence.
